label: Welcome
title: Money, without the mystery.
description: A minimal introduction carries the reference’s luminous lime surface, overlapping circles, and light numerical typography.

label: Monthly overview
title: Know where you stand.
description: A live balance, spending pace, and recent activity bring the month into focus.

label: Transactions
title: A month in the details.
description: An open transaction list groups purchases by date, with category filters and month navigation.

label: Expense detail
title: Every purchase has a place.
description: Clear amounts and compact metadata make a transaction easy to review, recategorize, or remove.

label: Add an expense
title: A quick, considered entry.
description: A large amount field and direct category choices make logging a purchase feel effortless.

label: Monthly budgets
title: A little structure goes a long way.
description: Category budgets show the amount spent, room remaining, and clear over-budget states.

label: Category detail
title: Understand the overrun.
description: A category view connects its budget to the purchases that shaped it.

label: Set your budget
title: Make room for what matters.
description: Category limits roll into one monthly budget, with a live preview before saving.

label: Spending insights
title: See the pattern behind the purchases.
description: Cumulative spending and category shares reveal how the month is developing.

label: Subscriptions
title: The small things add up.
description: Active commitments, monthly equivalents, and upcoming charges are gathered in one view.

label: Subscription detail
title: A clearer recurring commitment.
description: Price, cadence, renewal date, and reminder controls make recurring spending visible.

label: Add a subscription
title: No more invisible renewals.
description: Capture a service, its price, its billing cycle, and its next renewal date.

label: Renewal calendar
title: Know what is coming.
description: A calendar marks renewal days and reveals the charges expected on each date.

label: Budget alerts
title: A useful heads-up.
description: Overspending and renewal reminders are separate from delivery preferences.

label: Search expenses
title: Find a purchase in a moment.
description: Search merchant names, categories, and notes, with contextual results and a useful empty state.

label: Settings
title: Your money. Your preferences.
description: Simple grouped settings cover privacy, notifications, budget setup, and local demo data.

label: Monthly summary
title: The month, in perspective.
description: One report connects total spending, remaining budget, category totals, and recurring commitments.
